show.description: At a lavish billionaire wedding, a dignified pregnant woman, Harshita, faces humiliation from two girls who judge her by appearance. Unaware she is the sister-in-law of powerful CEO Rudra Taneja, they later meet her again at the wedding. Their past behavior returns to haunt them, leading to intense confrontations, shattered egos, and a powerful lesson that true dignity often hides behind simplicity.
